scope.score_population: hourly events only; each score is based on one case, lead, threshold, and fixed point set
scope.observation_product: ODAM RN1 analysis product under supplied one-hour/mm convention
scope.input_evidence: supplied complete six-threshold hourly contingency-count CSV; CSV counts are validated, but their provenance is not independently verified

definitions.CSI: H / (H + M + F); null if denominator is zero or event is not evaluated
definitions.POD: H / (H + M); null if denominator is zero
definitions.FAR: F / (H + F); null if denominator is zero
definitions.frequency_bias: (H + F) / (H + M); null if denominator is zero

limitations: RN1 is a processed radar/AWS analysis; a separate radar-coverage validity mask is not archived.
The result scores supplied contingency counts and is not a raw-observation reanalysis or new forecast validation.
One case and one six-hour period do not establish statistical generality or an isolated physical mechanism.
